title: Write Blog Post: 'Getting Around JB Without a Car — Transport Guide for Backpackers'
description: Publish original SEO-optimized travel article targeting backpackers with practical JB transport tips (buses, trains, taxis, ride-sharing). Article should include Article JSON-LD schema, internal links to /guide and /book pages, and estimated reading time. Drives long-tail search traffic for 'how to get around JB' and 'JB public transport for tourists'.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post renders at /blog/jb-transport-guide with Article schema containing articleBody, author, datePublished, headline, and mainEntityOfPage
Post includes minimum 1500 words covering JB transport modes (buses, LRT, taxis, Grab), pricing examples, and day-trip logistics
Post appears in /feed.xml RSS feed with correct publication date, excerpt, and canonical URL
technicalNotes: Create: site/src/content/blog/jb-transport-guide.mdx with frontmatter (title, date, author, description, tags)
Update: site/src/data/blogPosts.ts to register post with excerpt and featured status
Update: site/src/app/sitemap.ts to include /blog/jb-transport-guide in URL list
Test command: rtk curl http://localhost:3000/blog/jb-transport-guide | grep -q '"@type":"Article"' && rtk curl http://localhost:3000/feed.xml | grep -q 'jb-transport-guide'

title: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD Schema to Blog Post Template
description: Enhance structured data on all blog posts by implementing BreadcrumbList schema (Home > Blog > Article Title). This improves Google Search rich results and breadcrumb navigation UX. Schema must include position, name, and item URL for each breadcrumb level.
acceptanceCriteria: BreadcrumbList JSON-LD renders in <head> of every blog post page with correct hierarchy: home (position 1) > blog listing (position 2) > current post title (position 3)
Breadcrumb itemListElement includes valid @id URLs for each level matching canonical URLs
Schema validates against schema.org BreadcrumbList without errors
technicalNotes: Create function: site/src/lib/schema.ts - generateBreadcrumbList(pathname: string, title: string) returning JSON-LD object
Update: site/src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx to call breadcrumb generator in metadata() and inject into StructuredData component
Test command: rtk npm run build && rtk curl http://localhost:3000/blog/jb-transport-guide | grep -o '"BreadcrumbList"' && npm run test -- site/src/lib/schema.test.ts

title: Add RSS Auto-discovery Link to HTML Head
description: Enable RSS feed auto-discovery by adding <link rel='alternate' type='application/rss+xml'> tag to the HTML <head>. Allows RSS readers and browsers to detect /feed.xml endpoint automatically. Single-line addition with high SEO and usability impact.
acceptanceCriteria: HTML <head> contains <link rel='alternate' type='application/rss+xml' href='/feed.xml' title='Pelangi Blog Feed'> on all pages
RSS readers (Feedly, Pocket, etc.) auto-detect feed via standard discovery mechanism
No HTTP errors when accessing /feed.xml; Content-Type header is 'application/rss+xml'
technicalNotes: Update: site/src/app/layout.tsx - add <link> tag in <head> section within RootLayout component
Verify: site/src/app/feed.xml/route.ts (or similar) returns correct Content-Type header
Test command: rtk curl -I http://localhost:3000/feed.xml | grep 'Content-Type: application/rss' && rtk curl http://localhost:3000 | grep 'rel.*alternate.*rss'

title: Create 'JB News & Updates' RSS Widget Component for Homepage
description: Build reusable React component that fetches from 3-5 curated Malaysian news RSS sources (e.g., Malay Mail, The Star, Bernama) and displays latest JB-related headlines on homepage. Component should include error boundaries, loading state, and cache news for 1 hour to avoid excessive feed polling.
acceptanceCriteria: JBNewsWidget component renders 5-8 latest headlines from curated RSS feeds with title, summary excerpt, and publish date
Component displays 'Loading news...' skeleton during fetch and gracefully shows 'News unavailable' if feed fetch fails (no error thrown)
News items are cached for 60 minutes; subsequent renders within cache window reuse data without re-fetching
technicalNotes: Create: site/src/components/JBNewsWidget.tsx - React component with useState/useEffect for RSS fetching, or use Server Component with fetch()
Create: site/src/lib/rss.ts - parseRSSFeed(feedUrl: string) function that extracts title, link, pubDate, description from RSS XML
Update: site/src/app/page.tsx to import and render JBNewsWidget in appropriate section (e.g., below hero or before footer)
Test command: npm run test -- site/src/lib/rss.test.ts && npm run test -- site/src/components/JBNewsWidget.test.tsx

title: Write Blog Post: 'JB Shopping Guide — Where to Find Cheap Deals in Johor Bahru'
description: Publish comprehensive SEO-targeted guide for budget-conscious travelers shopping in JB. Cover specific locations (City Square, Aeon, Imago, street markets), store types, bargaining tips, and estimated price ranges for common items. Target long-tail keywords like 'cheap shopping in JB', 'JB bargain hunting', 'JB souvenir prices'.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post published at /blog/jb-shopping-guide with minimum 1500 words, 4-6 internal links to /guide and /amenities, and H2/H3 structure (Shopping Malls, Bazaars, Souvenir Tips, Money-Saving Hacks)
Post includes Article schema with correct articleBody, wordCount, articleSection, and hasPart for subsections
Post appears in blog listing page (/blog) with excerpt, thumbnail, and reading time estimate
technicalNotes: Create: site/src/content/blog/jb-shopping-guide.mdx with frontmatter: title, date, author, description, keywords (shopping, bargains, JB), featured=true
Update: site/src/data/blogPosts.ts with new post entry including slug, excerpt, and thumbnail image path
Test command: rtk npm run build && rtk npm run test -- site/src/data/blogPosts.test.ts && rtk curl http://localhost:3000/blog | grep -q 'jb-shopping-guide'
